scope: Complete local observational entry fence and exact execv source
limits: Process enumeration covers ordinary executable/script argv, not every possible shell invocation; canonical atomic shared lock retains authority.
Checks are sequential observations and root-only private custody, not atomic protection against another authorized root writer.
Exact production and dependency metadata must refuse on changed state; no blind retry or auto-refresh of constants.
No runtime, deployment or public acceptance is granted by this review.
